_comment: Simulated odds (fight/odds/, odds-model 'simulated'): before an attack, `runs` headless auto-fights of the current squad against enemies drawn by the region's own rules (faction, act tier, defense level) give a win rate. The label is the first band whose min_win_percent the rate reaches, best first; the bands' order also picks the map's odds colors. Every number is a first guess; see the calibration table in the PR that added this file.
